name: coffloader_linux
author: jm33-ng
comment: Load and execute Linux relocatable BOFs in memory. A dependency for Linux 'coff' modules; not runnable directly.
help: Dependency module only: maps and executes Linux relocatable BOFs in memory for modules of type coff. It has no entry point and cannot be run directly. Declare coffloader_linux in a BOF module's dependencies; the loader is mapped on demand.
